t: Justices Sunita Agarwal (former Chief Justice of the Gujarat High Court), Devendra Kumar Upadhyaya (former Chief Justice of the Delhi and Bombay High Courts) and Aparesh Kumar Singh (former Chief Justice of the Telangana High Court) were sworn in as Supreme Court judges on 6 October 2026.

The 5th edition of the India-Australia joint military exercise AUSTRAHIND began in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, and runs until 1 November 2026; a New Zealand observer delegation is attending for the first time.
Deepthi Jeevanji won gold in the women's 400m T20 at the 2026 Asian Para Games in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan, in a Games-record 56.36 seconds.
Simran won gold in the women's 200m T12 at the 2026 Asian Para Games in a Games-record 24.80 seconds; Tejalben Damor took bronze in the same event.
ISRO plans to launch NVS-03, the third second-generation NavIC navigation satellite, on a GSLV Mk II from Sriharikota; GKToday (22 October 2026) reported a 30 October launch date.
